title: Non-anchor position period prediction v41
rationale: This lane is a preregistered absolute-position period target, not another public-anchor mining pass. Discovery uses only a predeclared structural rule over one-based K4 positions and excludes public known-plaintext anchors, additive fragment values, candidate key material, routed-key results, held-out anchor controls, and prior public-fragment screens as evidence.
prediction_target: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched in one or more predeclared one-based absolute-position residue classes from the registered period family at a rate exceeding seeded null, best-of-period, and multiple-comparison controls.
discovery_inputs: Absolute one-based K4 position residues for the registered period family, emitted before future observation scoring
K4 ciphertext length and known clue positions used only as an exclusion mask for the non-anchor complement before scoring
Residue classes emitted before observing or scoring any future source-backed position evidence
evaluation_inputs: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations
Source-reviewed observation files with source IDs, one-based positions, per-position notes, and rationale declared before evaluation
Position-only scoring target that excludes public anchor additive fragments as primary evidence
controls: seeded same-size non-anchor position shuffle baseline
best-of-period null control across the registered period family
multiple-comparison correction across declared residue classes
require-unique-artifact gate before treating this as a distinct prediction target
promotion blocked unless future independent observations beat all predeclared controls without post-hoc retuning
